reward_shape_lineage:
Isaac-Asimov1-FallRecovery-v0 -- resumed from asimov1_fallrecovery_posealign_validated (iteration 21493, 88.0% phase-stitch handoff success) across 3 further resumed runs, all chained, 27490 total iterations. All three driven by a NEW per-handoff joint-position diagnostic added this session (play_asimov1_phase_stitch.py --joint_diag_log): logs the full 23-joint vector at every real RECOVER->WALK handoff, tagged with its eventual outcome, so each fix below was confirmed against real failure data, not guessed.
- Retrain #5 (21493->23492, +2000 iter): added recovery_hip_symmetry_l2 (penalizes LEFT-RIGHT hip_roll/hip_yaw asymmetry, weight=-3.0/ratio 3:1) after the diagnostic found 2 of 6 observed failures had a hip_roll asymmetry z-score of +9.0/+14.9 against the success population (std ~0.024 rad) -- a massive, specific outlier that the existing aggregate recovery_pose_alignment term (sums error across all 23 joints into one signal) was diluting. Handoff success rose 88.0% -> 89.4% (corrected number -- see the stdout-truncation bug note below).
- Retrain #6 (23492->25491, +2000 iter): added recovery_feet_planted (RecoveryFeetPlantedBonus, mirrors StabilityHoldBonus's consecutive-counter pattern but tracks CONTINUOUS foot ground-contact specifically, weight=2.0, required_ticks=30) after the user's own live observation of visible foot-tapping and overall body-wiggling post-recovery -- confirmed there is NO push mechanism in this task's training at all, so the wiggling was the policy's own learned behavior, not a disturbance response. Handoff success rose to 90.0% (corrected). An EARLIER attempt in this same session (feet_slide + recovery_position_drift at full weight) REGRESSED the rate to 61.5% despite correctly reducing visible sliding -- rolled back, weights halved, paired with recovery_pose_alignment (added the session before this one) which pulls the final joint config toward WALKING_HANDOFF_TARGET_JOINT_POS.
- Retrain #7 (25491->27490, +2000 iter, THIS CHECKPOINT): added recovery_knee_bend_l2 (penalizes absolute knee-bend deviation from the walking policy's own 0.38/-0.38 target, weight=-2.0) after discovering BOTH success and fail handoffs showed knees sitting near 0.0 (straight), nowhere near target, despite recovery_pose_alignment logging near its max WEIGHTED value (0.96-0.97) -- the raw term value is that divided by its own weight=2.0, ~0.48, a much more modest number once correctly unweighted, consistent with the knees being persistently off-target the whole episode. Result: handoff success held flat at 90.0% (tied with retrain #6) -- the reward engaged during training (-0.44 to -0.47 average) but did NOT change the actual knee value at the exact handoff instant. A follow-up zero-retraining test (raising the phase-stitch script's own STAND_HOLD_TICKS from 3 to 20, to test whether more settle time before handoff would help) got the robot stuck in RECOVER for 100+ seconds and was reverted -- the knee-bend-at-handoff gap remains unresolved, flagged as a known open item.
Also found and fixed in this session: a real measurement bug in play_asimov1_phase_stitch.py's own stdout transition log (silently lost data on long runs, confirmed by cross-checking against the new --joint_diag_log file's own explicitly-flushed record count) -- fixed via sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True). The originally-reported 90.2%/91.7% numbers for retrains #5/#6 were inflated by this bug; the numbers above are the corrected ones.
